Messages.Body:
I wish I had nearly enough Redcap Wilders to put this in action, but I'm
still interested in the answer to this question:

When Marconius employs a Redcap Wilder the normal way, it is (obviously)
free, reduced in cost by his text and the superior version of Redcap.

But what if Marconius had Trophy: Retainers?
Trophy: Retainers says "pay cost as normal".
Does that allow the superior text of Redcap Wilder to kick in, so it's
still free for him?
